notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two energy counters.
Genesis Chamber is untapped.
description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc and Genesis Chamber.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc.
Resolve both Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.
